tts.director_notes: Male American narrator (natural General American accent) for a fun US backyard-engineering social video. Warm, excited, storytelling energy with a wink of dad humor; fast and punchy (about 175 words per minute), short dramatic pause before the big reveal, lively intonation, never monotone, never salesy, never shouting.

beats.text: Storm rolls through, and boom, the whole street goes dark. Again. Last year the average American home sat without power for about eleven hours. Bolts was done waiting.
So he's building a wind turbine taller than his house. Fifty feet of steel, up on the windy ridge out back. And yes, he pulled the permit first.
Here's the deal. Wind pushes three blades, the blades spin a generator, and a tail keeps the whole thing pointed into the breeze. Power runs down a buried cable to a battery bank in the shed.
